name: cotra
description: Local-first MCP gateway with 20 bounded tools and local approval for computer changes.
long_description: Cotra exposes 20 bounded tools (workspace files, local Git, one argv-only process target) through a local policy kernel with per-action approval. This extension launches the installed Cotra entrypoint over stdio. It requires Cotra 0.1.0 installed and at least one configured workspace. No tunnel is required.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Read Cotra daemon status.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: Read the configured trusted workspace metadata.

tools.name: fs_stat
tools.description: Read metadata for a relative path inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List one directory inside a trusted workspace without following symlinks.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read one bounded UTF-8 text file inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Search bounded UTF-8 text files inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_write_preview
tools.description: Preview an exact UTF-8 file write without mutating the computer.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Write exact UTF-8 content inside a trusted workspace after local approval.

tools.name: process_spawn
tools.description: Execute one argv-only process after fresh local approval.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Read Git working-tree and branch status.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Read a bounded Git diff.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Read bounded Git commit history.

tools.name: git_branch_create
tools.description: Create and switch to one new local Git branch after approval.

tools.name: git_stage
tools.description: Stage listed files after approval.

tools.name: git_unstage
tools.description: Unstage listed files after approval.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Create one local Git commit after approval.

tools.name: git_fetch_preview
tools.description: Preview one bounded Git HTTPS fetch without mutation.

tools.name: git_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one validated branch after approval.

tools.name: git_push_preview
tools.description: Preview one bounded Git HTTPS push without mutation.

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push one validated branch after approval.
